parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the need to build a complete Unidecode-compatible package with transliteration tables, API behavior, CLI support including base64 input, tests, docs, packaging, Python typing, and final delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent delegated upstream API, table, and test inspection to child agents while it downloaded and assembled the package, then kept implementation and final verification ownership in the parent.
parallel.implementation: The parent used an upstream Unidecode 1.4.0 source baseline, refreshed the table modules and metadata, added CLI/base64 behavior, typed API exports, documentation, tests, and packaging files.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent consumed the completed table child report, reconciled a child-written partial CLI implementation after a patch context failure, interrupted two still-running children near closure, cleaned transient artifacts, and delivered the workspace.
parallel.verification: The parent reported local verification with `pytest -q` returning 71 passed, `python -m mypy unidecode` reporting no issues, editable installation succeeding, and CLI smoke checks for normal and base64 input.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed but the parallel artifact still failed one hidden test, and the raw evidence does not expose which hidden requirement caused that remaining failure.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same broad Unidecode package requirements, including API behavior, valid surrogate-pair handling, CLI base64 input, error-mode options, docs, tests, packaging metadata, and py.typed support.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial run used one actor for the full pipeline: inspect an upstream baseline, implement API and CLI behavior, update packaging and tests, run tests, package smoke test, and close out.
serial.implementation: The serial agent built from an Unidecode 1.3.8-oriented baseline, patched surrogate handling, CLI base64 and error modes, README doctests, MANIFEST/tox/setup config, coverage support, and benchmark/gitignore files.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial integration happened within one live writer, so there was no child handoff or shared-file race; the agent made the CLI patch and subsequent fixes in a single ordered trajectory.
serial.verification: The first local pytest run failed four strict/invalid exception-chain tests, the agent fixed the fallback path, then `pytest -q` returned 65 passed and packaged smoke checks succeeded.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed but the serial artifact failed seven hidden tests despite local success; the exact hidden failures are not visible in the allowed inputs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel treated the task as a full Unidecode package reconstruction with tables, API, CLI, tests, docs, packaging, and type markers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task surface and implemented API, CLI, tests, packaging, docs, and typing in one actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized obligations substantially matched; the material difference was baseline and breadth of upstream refresh, not a missing stated requirement in one prompt interpretation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spawned children for upstream API, table, and test inspection, while the parent retained implementation and final delivery ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial disabled multi-agent execution and one actor owned inspection, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used research fan-out with parent-owned assembly; serial used one continuous ownership chain with no child dependencies.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The table child returned concise actionable findings that the parent could use; API and test children remained live until late interruption.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial preserved task context internally and did not need to serialize child briefs, interface contracts, or result handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No retained context-loss or missing-contract pattern is proven, but parallel had explicit parent/child information boundaries while serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel populated a 1.4.0-style implementation with refreshed tables, typed core API, CLI/base64 support, docs, packaging, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a 1.3.8-style package with surrogate-pair support, CLI base64/error modes, docs, packaging, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel appears closer to the newer upstream package and earned a higher official score, while serial made a narrower implementation that passed local tests but failed more hidden tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The completed table result reached the parent and was available before closure; API and test children were interrupted after the parent had already verified and delivered.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join and instead advanced through local failure, fix, pass, package smoke test, and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had late child lifecycle events, but the visible completed result was used and the interrupted children are not proven to contain needed unreturned work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: A child wrote `unidecode/util.py` in the shared workspace and the parent later hit an apply-patch context failure on the same file before reconciling it.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial applied the analogous CLI patch in a single actor and the patch succeeded without another live writer changing the file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete parallel-only adverse coordination episode: a same-file collision causing re-read and reconciliation work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reported 71 local tests passing, mypy clean, editable install success, and CLI smoke checks before final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial first saw four local pytest failures, fixed them, then reported 65 local tests passing and packaged smoke checks before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel performed broader local verification and still failed one hidden official test; serial local verification was sufficient for its visible suite but missed more hidden behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed in about 454 agent seconds, interrupted two still-running children near closure, and official evaluation completed with 64 of 65 passing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in about 361 agent seconds with no child budget, no host timeout, and official evaluation completed with 58 of 65 passing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used more time and child slots but did not time out; the late child interruptions are closure management events, not proven budget exhaustion or outcome causes.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The substantive quality difference is that the parallel artifact passed 64 of 65 tests after a broader 1.4.0-oriented refresh and wider local checks, while the serial artifact passed 58 of 65 after a narrower single-agent implementation. The retained same-file collision explains an adverse parallel process cost, not the official relation or the hidden failure.
parallel_contributors: Used child inspection and an upstream 1.4.0 source refresh, producing broader table coverage and higher official score.
Encountered one shared-file collision on the CLI path but recovered and completed local verification.
serial_contributors: Kept a single ordered implementation path with no child coordination overhead.
Passed visible local tests and package smoke checks but failed seven hidden official tests.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel refreshed to Unidecode 1.4.0-style metadata and tables, whereas serial remained closer to a 1.3.8 baseline.
Serial local success did not cover the hidden evaluator surface as well as the parallel attempt.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative contributors and one adverse parallel process episode, not an exclusive root cause.
